correctness.rationale: An exhaustive generator constructs 50 facets on 41 vertices and all 2,517,787 nonempty faces. Ordered-pivot discrete Morse matching leaves one critical vertex and two four-dimensional cells, giving known integral homotopy S^4 wedge S^4. Direct signed fixed-face traces and independent invariant-orbit enumeration agree for every element of C2 x C2: (2,-2,0,0) on H4. The finite-group rational character calculation determines the two one-dimensional summands and quotient invariant Betti ranks. Each computation is reproduced by the embedded standalone script and output; no infinite-family claim is made.

value.rationale: The first asymmetric 2x2x3 honeycomb after the prominent regular 2x2x2 case has two independent reflection/half-turn symmetry mechanisms. Its known two-sphere Betti rank does not determine whether any homology survives each natural symmetry quotient. The new exact traces show a sharp distinction: the swap quotient is rationally acyclic but the half-turn and other-reflection quotients retain one class each. This is a natural invariant of a canonical finite family member with a full reproducible certificate, not a routine recomputation of a known Betti rank.
